# The archives `make dist` writes: the one table every tool reads (tools/pkgs.py).
# Columns are separated by two or more spaces; "-" is an empty value.
#   id          short name used by the Makefile, the tests and the rig scripts
#   archive     the lha archive and the drawer in it
#   version     <major>.<minor> of this archive
#   needs-base  lowest base version the archive needs; "-" for the base itself
#               and for a stand-alone package (own name, no UP-Term prefix: it
#               installs on a Workbench with no UP-Term, K2-1 and the owner 2026-10-13)
#   ixemul      lowest ixemul.library version the archive needs. With a needs-base
#               it is the base's (nvim: "80", the patched library). A stand-alone
#               archive with a version here carries an ixemul.library of its own and
#               installs it only when no library of that version or newer is there
#               (Python3: 47, never a downgrade, never over UP-Term's patched one)
#   record      where an install leaves its MANIFEST, VERSIONS and options:
#               UP-Term:pkg/<archive> when it needs the base, ENVARC:upkg/<archive>
#               when it stands alone
#   handed      kit paths (comma separated) the base hands over to this
#               archive: the base's Update leaves them alone (kit-split D7)
#   consumes    the repositories (comma separated; vtcon is this one) the archive is
#               built from: the lines of its Files/VERSIONS (tools/mkversions.sh)
# id    archive    version  needs-base  ixemul  record                 handed                                                consumes
base    up-term    1.6      -           -       UP-Term:               -                                                     vtcon,ixemul-vtcon,upterm-ports,tmux-amiga,screen-amiga/src
claude  up-claude  1.1      -           -       ENVARC:upkg/up-claude  Files/Claude                                          vtcon
pi      up-pi      1.0      -           -       ENVARC:upkg/up-pi      Files/amiga-pi                                        amiga-pi,vtcon
nvim    up-nvim    1.0      1.0         80      UP-Term:pkg/up-nvim    Files/nvim                                            neovim-amiga,ixemul-vtcon
python  up-python  1.0      -           47      ENVARC:upkg/up-python  Files/python3                                         cpython-amiga,ixemul-vtcon
git     up-git     1.0      1.0         80      UP-Term:pkg/up-git     Files/userland/bin/git,Files/userland/share/git-core  upterm-ports,ixemul-vtcon
perl    up-perl    1.0      1.0         80      UP-Term:pkg/up-perl    Files/userland/bin/perl                               upterm-ports,ixemul-vtcon
vim     up-vim     1.0      1.0         80      UP-Term:pkg/up-vim     Files/userland/bin/vim,Files/userland/share/vim       upterm-ports,ixemul-vtcon
